xgboost.interpretation: Fixed observed-transaction replay; censored demand and dispatch timing unobserved. Not a causal policy effect.

gcn.interpretation: Fixed observed-transaction replay; censored demand and dispatch timing unobserved. Not a causal policy effect.

gcn_flow.interpretation: Fixed observed-transaction replay; censored demand and dispatch timing unobserved. Not a causal policy effect.

gcn_flow_calibrated.interpretation: Fixed observed-transaction replay; censored demand and dispatch timing unobserved. Not a causal policy effect.

limitations: Observed transactions, not identified latent demand.
Hourly endpoint stockout labels; intra-hour events are unobserved.
Rentals occur before returns in the simulator.
GCN/XGBoost probabilities use independent Poisson scenarios.
Direct transfer batches; no road routing, dispatch timing or causal policy guarantee.
Calibration fitted on validation only; selected on that same validation set. Single seed; no uncertainty interval for score differences.
Replay holds observed transactions fixed; not causal avoided stockouts or uncensored demand.
